title: Build an LRU Cache in Python using OrderedDict
description: Greenfield Python task: implement an LRUCache class with fixed capacity that supports O(1) get and put, evicting the least-recently-used entry when full.

injections.content:
import pytest
from src.lru_cache import LRUCache


def test_get_missing_returns_minus_one():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    assert cache.get(1) == -1


def test_put_and_get():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 10)
    assert cache.get(1) == 10


def test_evicts_lru_on_overflow():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    cache.put(3, 3)  # evicts key 1 (least recently used)
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert cache.get(2) == 2
    assert cache.get(3) == 3


def test_get_updates_recency():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    cache.get(1)      # key 1 is now most recently used
    cache.put(3, 3)   # evicts key 2, not key 1
    assert cache.get(1) == 1
    assert cache.get(2) == -1
    assert cache.get(3) == 3


def test_put_updates_existing_value():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 100)
    cache.put(1, 200)
    assert cache.get(1) == 200


def test_put_existing_key_updates_recency():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    cache.put(1, 10)  # update key 1 — becomes MRU
    cache.put(3, 3)   # evicts key 2 (LRU), not key 1
    assert cache.get(1) == 10
    assert cache.get(2) == -1
    assert cache.get(3) == 3


def test_capacity_one():
    cache = LRUCache(1)
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)  # evicts key 1
    assert cache.get(1) == -1
    assert cache.get(2) == 2
